summary: RYPPL MVP tested end-to-end. Backend: 28/28 pytest cases passed covering auth (send-otp, verify-otp with invalid-OTP rejection, packer/runner sub_role, /auth/me), products+categories+trending+search+filter, promo (RYPPL20/WELCOME5/SNACK10/invalid), orders (subtotal/discount/delivery_fee/tip/total math, points awarded, persistence, listing), and full employee lifecycle (packer claim → packing → ready → runner claim → in_bag → on_road → complete) with optimistic-lock 409 on double-claim and 403 on customer hitting /employee/*. Frontend: verified customer sign-in → OTP → Home (categories chip row + product grid + hero banner) → product detail modal → add to cart → floating cart bar → Cart with RYPPL20 promo applied (-$0.40 on $1.99), tip select, building/room, Place Order → Order Tracking screen with SVG map + timeline. Employee flow verified: runner/packer login → Order Queue with segmented Packer/Runner control, Map tab renders stylized SVG campus map with color-coded pins, tapping Claim navigates to delivery/[id] with Start Packing → Mark Ready flow (mark-ready gated by 'check all items' UX). No deprecated Expo packages (expo-av / barcode-scanner / background-fetch) present. Only minor console warnings (RN-web shadow* props deprecated, React 19 element.ref warning from a lib) — not blocking.

issues: Header subtitle is a static 'Packing' / 'Delivery' string, not the live order status label — first-time viewers may find it confusing while the card below shows the true status.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warns 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow.' — appears on multiple screens. Non-blocking but should migrate to boxShadow for RN 0.76+/Web compatibility.
Console warns props.pointerEvents is deprecated; use style.pointerEvents. Non-blocking.

action_items: (Optional / low priority) Replace shadow* style props with boxShadow to silence RN-Web deprecation warnings.
(Optional) Consider showing the live status label in the delivery screen header subtitle instead of the static role string.
No functional issues — MVP ready for user review.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single 615-line file; still readable but approaching split-threshold — consider modularising (auth/, orders/, employee/, seed) as more features land.
verify-otp treats any 6-digit code as valid by design (simulated). Fine for MVP; make sure this is behind a feature flag before production.
Order create endpoint does not enforce a positive subtotal or non-empty items list — passing items=[] currently creates a $1.99 order (delivery fee only). Low-priority validation gap.
MongoDB _id is consistently excluded via projection {'_id': 0} — good.
seed_data_creation: Backend seed runs on startup (32 products, 3 promo codes, packer +15550000001, runner +15550000002). Tests also create fresh customers and orders on the fly (phones prefixed with random 7-digit numbers).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All auth/product/promo/order/employee endpoints and full state machine verified. Two employee tokens (packer/runner) are required for lifecycle tests — see fixtures in backend_test.py. Frontend base URL comes from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Use testIDs already wired: name-input, phone-input, send-otp-button, otp-input, verify-button, home-search, floating-cart-bar, promo-input, apply-promo, building-0..6, room-input, place-order-button, product-close, size-*, detail-qty, add-to-cart-button, segment-packer, segment-runner, sheet-claim-packer/runner, sheet-continue, start-packing, mark-ready (requires per-item pack-item-* toggles first), confirm-pickup, start-delivery, send-sms, mark-complete, open-maps, logout-button, share-referral.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no defects requiring RCA. All requested scenarios pass.
